title: TTYs.
officialText: Where a public pay telephone is provided in a transit facility (as defined by the Department of Transportation) at least one public TTY complying with Sections 704.4 through 704.7 of ICC A117.1 shall be provided in the station. In addition, where one or more public pay telephones serve a particular entrance to a transportation facility, at least one TTY telephone complying with Section 704.4 through 704.7 of ICC A117.1 shall be provided to serve that entrance.
